messages:
Kayla: Quick async check — starting a staggered rollout for feature flag `ablate-beta` now. Slice-1 -> 2% traffic. Post short updates: what you saw / blockers / any hotfixes?
Ben: slice-1 at 2% (≈10m in). Metrics look fine so far: p95 +30ms, error rate ~0.1%. No obvious regressions in model output.
Mira: saw a small GPU mem pressure bump on worker-8 ~5m ago, triggered one restart. Looking through logs now. Not a sustained failure yet.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: feature flag `ablate-beta` enabled for slice-1 (2%). Rollback policy: auto-abort thresholds set (errors >0.5% or p95 >200ms).
Tom: FYI I'm running the DB migration step — should be done in ~20m. Any chance the flag touches serialized configs?
Ben: No DB schema changes expected from this flag. It's a runtime toggle + routing. Avoid heavy infra maintenance during the next 30m if possible.
Kayla: @Mira if you keep seeing restarts can you paste the log snippet here and tag me? If it's memory-caused we should schedule a rolling restart of the affected workers and hold expansion.
Mira: copied logs: ```
[2029-06-12T15:21:03Z] worker-8: KV cache allocation failed: requested 128MB, available 64MB
[2029-06-12T15:21:04Z] worker-8: OOM-killer invoked, restarting process
[2029-06-12T15:21:06Z] worker-8: restart successful, reconnecting to router
```
Ben: Thanks — I kicked off a rolling restart for worker-8 and bumped its JVM/allocator config. Created ticket INF-1234 to track. :thumbsup:
Kayla: OK — plan: hold at 2% for another 15m. If no regressions we expand to slice-2 (10%). Abort criteria: errors >0.5% OR p95 >200ms OR new OOMs on any worker. If abort needed @Ben will flip the flag and run rollback playbook.
Ben: I'll own the abort. Ping me in thread and I'll flip `ablate-beta=false` and trigger the `rollback-playbook` runbook.
Tom: Migration finished early; no locks and no schema drift. Running a quick smoke test against staging now.
Kayla: Perfect. Please keep short notes here — I’ll post final status when we hit 10%. Thanks all.
